Afghan nationals arrested for Indian passports using fake addresses

The Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) arrested three Afghan nationals from Kolkata who had obtained Indian passports using fake addresses in Jabalpur. The suspects were residing in Jabalpur under assumed names. The ATS is investigating their origins and who provided them shelter.
